strings.categories.2.practical.notes.0: The exercise zones of the first stage for categories B, B1, C, C1, D, D1 are listed in para. 38 of the Examination Rules. The order and set of exercises at a particular test ground are set by its layout: the method on 24pdd.kz for Almaty marks some of the zones as “removed”.
strings.categories.2.practical.notes.1: The right to B1 is also confirmed by category B licences (since 05.04.2025) and category A licences - for vehicles with a motorcycle-style seating position or motorcycle-type handlebars (Road Traffic Act, art. 73(8)).

strings.categories.3.name: Category B: passenger cars
strings.categories.3.vehicles: Motor cars with a maximum authorised mass of not more than 3500 kg and not more than 8 seats in addition to the driver’s seat; such cars with a trailer of up to 750 kg; with a trailer heavier than 750 kg - if the mass of the trailer is not more than the unladen mass of the car and the total maximum authorised mass of the combination is not more than 3500 kg ⟦23⟧.
strings.categories.3.age: 18 years (art. 74(2)). From 17, people who have completed training on a referral from the local military administration bodies are admitted to the test; the licence is issued from 18 (art. 74(3))
strings.categories.3.theory: General theory test at a specialised PSC (Public Service Centre): 40 questions, 40 minutes, at least 32 correct answers required, language - Kazakh, Russian or English ⟦24⟧. If you are opening several categories at once, you take the theory test only once ⟦25⟧. Whether the set of questions differs by category is not officially confirmed (see notes).
strings.categories.3.practical.where: Automated test ground of the State Corporation “Government for Citizens” (specialised PSC), assessed by an automatic system ⟦26⟧. Theory first, then the practical test ⟦27⟧.
strings.categories.3.practical.vehicle: Motor car with a maximum authorised mass of not more than 3500 kg, not more than 8 seats in addition to the driver’s seat, capable of reaching a speed of at least 100 km/h ⟦28⟧. The car is provided by the State Corporation.

strings.categories.3.practical.notes.1: A detailed description of the exercises and penalties is in the practical test section (practice.json).
strings.categories.3.practical.notes.2: Since 05.04.2025, a category B licence confirms the right to both A1 and B1 (Road Traffic Act, art. 73(8)).

strings.categories.4.name: Category BE: passenger car with a heavy trailer
strings.categories.4.vehicles: A category B motor car with a trailer whose maximum authorised mass is more than 750 kg and more than the unladen mass of the car; or with a trailer of more than 750 kg if the total maximum authorised mass of the combination is more than 3500 kg ⟦29⟧.
strings.categories.4.age: Not set separately: you need to have held the right to category B for at least 12 months, so usually not before 19
strings.categories.4.experience: At least 12 months of holding the right to drive vehicles of category B (art. 74(2))
strings.categories.4.theory: General theory test at a specialised PSC (Public Service Centre): 40 questions, 40 minutes, at least 32 correct answers required, language - Kazakh, Russian or English ⟦30⟧. If you are opening several categories at once, you take the theory test only once ⟦31⟧. Whether the set of questions differs by category is not officially confirmed (see notes).
strings.categories.4.practical.where: Automated test ground of the State Corporation “Government for Citizens” (specialised PSC), assessed by an automatic system ⟦32⟧. Theory first, then the practical test ⟦33⟧.
strings.categories.4.practical.vehicle: Category BE combination (para. 40: the test is taken on a vehicle of the category for which the licence is issued)
strings.categories.4.practical.exercises.1: Exercises for combinations follow the test ground layout (the list is not published in the Examination Rules)
strings.categories.4.practical.notes.0: For BE, CE, C1E, DE and D1E, para. 39 of the Examination Rules describes only the zone markings: control lines 1.4, yellow broken lines marking the start and end of exercises (width 0.10 m, dash 0.15 m, gap 0.10 m), white “Start” and “Finish” lines 0.4 m wide, lettering 1 m from the lines.
strings.categories.4.practical.notes.1: The practical test is taken on a vehicle of the category for which the licence is issued ⟦34⟧, and separately from the base category ⟦35⟧. We did not find a list of exercises and penalties for combinations in open sources: ask for the layout at the specialised PSC or the training organisation.
strings.categories.4.practical.notes.2: Passenger car with a trailer outside built-up areas: not more than 90 km/h on a motorway, 80 on a road with a central reservation, 70 on other roads (para. 74(3) of the Rules).
